task.description:
Write unit test specifications and test source files for API-07 (Input validation).

Create test spec at tests/specs/API-07.md covering:
- TC-API-07-01: Missing required field → HTTP 422 with field error
- TC-API-07-02: Wrong type field → HTTP 422 with type error
- TC-API-07-03: Multiple errors → all listed in response
- TC-API-07-04: Empty required string → treated as missing, HTTP 422
- TC-API-07-05: Malformed JSON body → HTTP 400
- TC-API-07-06: Valid payload → validation passes, no errors
- TC-API-07-07: Validation runs before business logic (no side effects)

Write test source files under tests/unit/ for the validation module.

Per the test developer guide: use the standard test format, define test data factories where needed.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/API-07.md created with all test cases
Test source files created under tests/unit/
All test cases cover API-07 acceptance criteria
Edge cases covered: malformed JSON, empty strings, multiple errors

result.summary: Test specs and unit tests for API-07 (Input validation). Created tests/specs/API-07.md with 24 test cases covering all 7 acceptance criteria plus edge cases. Created tests/unit/test_api07_validation.zig with 36 unit tests. All 36 tests pass. Fixed pre-existing Zig 0.16 API issues in src/api/validation.zig (std.regex removal, ArrayList.init removal, writer() removal, toOwnedSlice signature, std.json.stringify removal, error set narrowing). 8 minor memory leaks remain in validate() parseFromValue arena management (implementation concern).

issues.description: validate() leaks arena from parseFromValue on success path (8 leaks in test run). The parsed struct arena is never deinit'd. Consider returning Parsed(T) or copying strings before deinit.
